documents.name: Content/Terms & Conditions
documents.copy:
1. Parent or guardian account

A parent or legal guardian manages the family account. Confirm that you are 18 years or older before continuing. Children use a child profile supervised by their parent or guardian.

2. Child’s age

A parent or guardian provides the child’s date of birth when adding a child profile. The app uses the resulting age band to present suitable learning content and avatar choices. Do not enter another child’s real information in this prototype.

3. Child profile

The parent creates a profile using a nickname, date of birth, avatar, preferred language and learning level. The profile separates each child’s learning experience within the family account. Optional details should remain optional.

4. Child data and parent controls

Child profile information and learning progress support lessons, age-appropriate content and progress tracking. Child-data-processing consent is requested separately in the next step. Agreeing to these Terms does not turn on Personalization/AI, Voice-feature or Marketing consent.

5. Fictional sample data

Child name: Ayaan (sample)
Age: 7 years (sample)
Preferred language: English (sample)
Learning progress: 3 lessons completed (sample)

All examples are fictional. No actual child information is displayed or saved by this prototype.

6. Review and manage choices

The parent can review consent choices and use the approved privacy and support journeys to request help or changes. Optional preferences can be reviewed independently. Final legal terms, service conditions and available controls require legal and product review before release.

documents.name: Content/Privacy Policy
documents.copy:
1. What information is collected

Draft scope includes the parent’s phone number or email for authentication, and child profile information such as nickname, date of birth, avatar, preferred language, learning level and learning progress. Additional optional information must be described before it is collected.

2. Why it is collected and used

Account information supports sign-in and the family account. Child profile information supports age-band content, language preferences and separate profiles. Learning progress supports resuming lessons and showing progress to the parent.

3. Optional processing remains separate

Personalization/AI, Voice-feature and Marketing consent are independent and start off. Neither Terms agreement nor Privacy acknowledgement enables them. Voice features also require any applicable device permission before use. Optional choices can be changed without checking the other options.

4. How information is protected

Draft requirement: limit access to authorized purposes and protect child and parent information with appropriate technical and organizational safeguards. The final policy must accurately describe verified production controls, providers, storage, transfers and retention. This prototype makes no claim that those controls are implemented.

5. Access, correction and deletion

Parents should be able to request access to their family information, ask for corrections and request deletion through the app’s approved privacy or support journey. The final policy must specify the confirmed request route, verification steps, retention rules and response process. This prototype does not submit a data request.

6. Fictional example

Ayaan (sample) is 7 years old (sample), prefers English (sample), and has completed 3 lessons (sample). This illustrates profile and progress information only. It is fictional sample data, not a real child’s record.

7. Your acknowledgement

Review this draft Privacy Policy and make the separate child-data-processing choice below. Continuing acknowledges the Privacy Policy only; it does not enable optional processing. Close or go back without granting any unconfirmed consent.
